title: Elastic frame carousel
summary: Six stills cycle in a silent vertical loop. Each outgoing frame compresses toward the top edge while the next expands upward, turning every change into the subject.
use_when: A short silent reel needs motion from a set of still images
The scene changes should carry more energy than the individual frames
A looping editorial or product-image carousel needs one repeatable transition

look.type_style: small uppercase serif corner labels, regular weight, wide tracking, roughly 2% of frame height

sfx.event: each frame compresses and the next frame expands

structure.shot: first monochrome editorial still with two small corner labels
first still compresses toward the top while an exterior still expands upward from the bottom
structure.camera: fixed frame; scene layers deform vertically
structure.motion: vertical slide-push with opposing height scales, easings.inOutSine over 14 fr

structure.shot: exterior architecture still with the same two small corner labels
exterior still compresses toward the top while a dark product arrangement expands from below
structure.camera: fixed frame; scene layers deform vertically
structure.motion: vertical slide-push with opposing height scales, easings.inOutSine over 13 fr

structure.shot: dark still life of neutral containers with the recurring corner labels
still life compresses toward the top while a green portrait expands upward from the bottom
structure.camera: fixed frame; scene layers deform vertically
structure.motion: vertical slide-push with opposing height scales, easings.inOutSine over 17 fr

structure.shot: green-background portrait still with the recurring corner labels
portrait compresses toward the top while a light furniture still expands upward from below
structure.camera: fixed frame; scene layers deform vertically
structure.motion: vertical slide-push with opposing height scales, easings.inOutSine over 18 fr

structure.shot: light furniture still with the recurring corner labels
furniture still compresses toward the top while the first monochrome still returns from below
structure.camera: fixed frame; scene layers deform vertically
structure.motion: vertical slide-push with opposing height scales, easings.inOutSine over 15 fr

structure.shot: the first monochrome still returns and holds to close the loop

params.brand: any brand.json; text colour styles the optional corner labels
params.content.slides: five owned portrait stills under public/, or five deterministic brand-coloured demo art variants; the first returns after the fifth transition
params.content.labels: two optional short labels repeated at the left and right edges
params.transitionFrames: per-change durations at 30 fps; reference sequence is 14, 13, 17, 18 and 15 frames
params.holdFrames: still holds at 30 fps; reference sequence is 9, 31, 31, 26, 29 and 22 frames
params.aspect: 4:5 by default; layout may recompose to another supported aspect
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: The five soft changes run at frames 9-23, 54-67, 98-115, 141-159 and 188-203. ElasticFramePush compresses and expands whole frames vertically while a shared boundary travels upward. SFX are planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent. Transition curve shape and any sub-frame edge blur are not measurable at 0.25 s sheet resolution.
